summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  **Note:** I did a read-only audit (no edits) to ground this plan, since a plan on pure guesswork would be low-value for an item this trust-sensitive.  ### What I checked and what I found - **Client (`WatchlistPage.tsx`, `api.ts`):** Fetches/saves purely through `api.get/post/delete("/watchlist...")`, which sends cookies (`credentials: "include"`). No `localStorage`/`sessionStorage` fallback or caching of watchlist data anywhere in the watchlist code path — the only local storage in the client is an unrelated theme setting
